title: The Nice Slice
goal: Everything except the ends - as a view, not a copy.
hints: A range index borrows a window: &a[start..end], end exclusive.
1..=4 also compiles - inclusive ranges grab one more element than you think. The assert knows.
explanation: &a[1..4] borrows elements 1, 2, 3 - a view into the array, no copying, end index exclusive. The whole array fails the assert on shape; the inclusive range 1..=4 compiles fine and then fails at runtime with four elements - the off-by-one that slices make visible. Ranges are half-open by default for exactly this reason: end minus start is the length.
